title: History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.15715v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Linear attention promises the efficiency needed for long-context language modelling, yet its fixed-size recurrent state must simultaneously support ongoing computation and preserve information from an ever-growing history. This coupling has reinforced a prevailing view that the state's memory capacity defines the model's long-context capability. We challenge this presumed ceiling: \emph{recurrent computation need not bear the full burden of long-term storage}. We introduce NoteBank, a sparse episodic memory that archives selected text before future queries are known, uses the backbone's native features for writing and addressing, and reads retrieved evidence through its native forward computation via replay. This \emph{training-free, plug-and-play} interface requires no external embedding model, separately trained retriever, or separate neural reader. translated_title: 历史重演：释放线性注意力的长上下文能力
translated_abstract: 线性注意力为长上下文语言建模提供了所需的效率，然而其固定大小的循环状态必须同时支持正在进行的计算，并保存不断增长的历史信息。这种耦合强化了一种主流观点：状态的内存容量决定了模型的长上下文能力。我们挑战这一假定的上限：循环计算不必承担长期存储的全部负担。我们提出了NoteBank，这是一种稀疏的情景记忆，它在未来查询未知之前就归档选定的文本，使用骨干模型的原生特征进行写入和寻址，并通过“重放”机制利用其原生前向计算读取检索到的证据。这种无需训练、即插即用的接口不需要外部嵌入模型、单独训练的检索器或单独的神经读取器。在一百万token长度下，它将Gated DeltaNet在六个RULER检索任务上的平均准确率显著提升（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出NoteBank——一种无需训练、即插即用的稀疏情景记忆机制，通过预先归档文本并利用模型原生前向计算“重放”检索证据，突破了线性注意力固定状态内存容量对长上下文能力的限制。
en_tdlr: NoteBank, a training-free and plug-and-play sparse episodic memory that archives text before queries arrive and replays retrieved evidence through the model's native forward computation, breaks the presumed memory-capacity ceiling of linear attention for long-context tasks.
